svg.aria-label: A classroom seen from above with a wooden floor. Six paper posters are taped and pinned to the walls: Paragraph A, B and C on the top wall and Paragraph D, E and F on the bottom wall, each with a big letter and lines of text. Desks and chairs are pushed aside against the walls. In the centre a teacher holds up a question card: Question 1 — Data on skills is still limited. Where is it? Go! Six students holding papers walk along footprint trails toward different posters, with arrows showing where each one is going. On the left wall a scoreboard shows Team points: T1 three stars, T2 two stars, T3 four stars. On the right wall a clock timer shows 30 sec.
svg.title: Move to the paragraph — then prove it with the words in the text
svg.text: Move to the paragraph — then prove it with the words in the text
Data on skills is still limited.
